title: Composite Adaptive Synchronous Control of Dual-Drive Gantry Stage With Load Movement
publisher: IEEE Open Journal of the Industrial Electronics Society, Vol. 4, pp. 63–74
author: Pengwei Shi; Xinghu Yu; Xuebo Yang; Juan J. Rodríguez-Andina; Weichao Sun; Huijun Gao
locator: Moving load effects on the centroid/inertia and adaptive synchronization of a dual-drive gantry stage
notes: Research evidence that load movement can affect the studied gantry dynamics. Its plant and experiments do not transfer directly to a different CNC machine.
